title: CoreWeave and Nebius gain after report links Nvidia to major OpenAI infrastructure financing
excerpt: Shares of CoreWeave (NASDAQ:CRWV) and Nebius Group (NASDAQ:NBIS) moved higher on Monday after a report suggested Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) is considering a substa...
content_html:
Shares of CoreWeave (NASDAQ:CRWV) and Nebius Group (NASDAQ:NBIS) moved higher on Monday after a report suggested Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) is considering a substantial financing package to support OpenAI's next-generation data center expansion.

CoreWeave shares advanced 4%, while Nebius climbed 6% following a Wall Street Journal report that Nvidia is in discussions to provide approximately $250 billion in financing guarantees for a large-scale OpenAI infrastructure project.

Nvidia said to support massive Ohio data center development

According to the Wall Street Journal, citing people familiar with the discussions, the proposed financing would help OpenAI lease a planned 10-gigawatt data center campus being developed by SoftBank's energy subsidiary in southern Ohio.

The overall project is expected to exceed $500 billion in total investment, including the advanced AI chips that will power the facility.

The report said Nvidia's proposed $250 billion guarantee would back the project's lease obligations and debt financing but would not include financing for the semiconductor hardware itself.

Separately, Nvidia is also reportedly discussing financing for OpenAI chip purchases worth as much as $350 billion.

Deal could reshape AI infrastructure

If completed, the arrangement would represent a significant strategic shift for OpenAI, allowing the company to build greater control over its computing infrastructure instead of relying primarily on cloud capacity supplied by Microsoft, Amazon and Oracle.

For Nvidia, the agreement would help secure long-term demand for its AI chips as global investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure continues to accelerate.

The Wall Street Journal reported that the project's first phase is expected to come online in 2028, delivering roughly 800 megawatts of power. The electricity supply is reportedly controlled by the U.S. government and separately funded by Japan under a recent trade agreement linked to Tokyo's commitment to invest $33 billion in a natural gas facility.

Analysts see positive implications for AI infrastructure providers

Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Anurag Rana commented, "Nvidia's talks to provide a roughly $250 billion financing backstop for an OpenAI data-center lease, as reported by the Wall Street Journal, look constructive for CoreWeave, Crusoe Energy and other neoclouds. The structure suggests Nvidia is prepared to support larger AI infrastructure build-outs, easing concern that capacity demand is fading or that funding markets won't absorb the next wave of projects. Alphabet's capex increase last week pointed to sustained hyperscaler spending, and similar signals from Microsoft, Amazon and Meta this earnings season would reinforce our view that high-end AI computing remains supply-constrained. We'll watch whether Google makes similar credit-wrapper commitments to neocloud partners in its orbit, as it previously did with Fluidstack, and whether such backing lowers financing costs."

The report also reinforces expectations that investment in AI infrastructure will remain strong, particularly if other major technology companies continue increasing capital expenditure on advanced computing capacity.

content_html_zh:
CoreWeave（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWV）和 Nebius Group（纳斯达克股票代码：NBIS）的股价周一走高，此前有报道称 Nvidia（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）正在考虑提供大量融资方案以支持 OpenAI 的下一代数据中心扩张。

CoreWeave 股价上涨 4%，Nebius 上涨 6%，此前《华尔街日报》报道称 Nvidia 正在讨论为大型 OpenAI 基础设施项目提供约 2500 亿美元的融资担保。

英伟达表示将支持俄亥俄州大规模数据中心的开发

据《华尔街日报》援引知情人士的话称，拟议中的融资将帮助 OpenAI 租赁软银能源子公司在俄亥俄州南部正在开发的计划中的 10 吉瓦数据中心园区。

整个项目的总投资预计将超过 5000 亿美元，其中包括为该设施提供动力的先进人工智能芯片。

报道称，英伟达提出的 2500 亿美元担保将支持该项目的租赁义务和债务融资，但不包括半导体硬件本身的融资。

另外，据报道，Nvidia 还正在讨论为价值高达 3500 亿美元的 OpenAI 芯片采购融资。

交易可能重塑人工智能基础设施

如果完成，这一安排将代表 OpenAI 的重大战略转变，使该公司能够对其计算基础设施建立更大的控制权，而不是主要依赖微软、亚马逊和甲骨文提供的云能力。

对于英伟达来说，随着全球人工智能基础设施投资持续加速，该协议将有助于确保其人工智能芯片的长期需求。

据《华尔街日报》报道，该项目第一阶段预计将于 2028 年上线，提供约 800 兆瓦的电力。 据报道，电力供应由美国政府控制，并根据最近一项与东京承诺投资 330 亿美元建设天然气设施相关的贸易协议，由日本单独提供资金。

分析师认为人工智能基础设施提供商将产生积极影响

彭博资讯分析师 Anurag Rana 评论道：“据《华尔街日报》报道，Nvidia 正在为 OpenAI 数据中心租赁提供约 2500 亿美元的融资支持，这对 CoreWeave、Crusoe Energy 和其他 Neocloud 来说似乎具有建设性。 该结构表明，英伟达准备支持更大规模的人工智能基础设施建设，缓解人们对产能需求正在减弱或融资市场不会吸收下一波项目的担忧。 Alphabet 上周的资本支出增加表明超大规模支出持续存在，而微软、亚马逊和 Meta 在本财报季发出的类似信号将强化我们的观点，即高端人工智能计算仍然受到供应限制。 我们将关注谷歌是否向其轨道上的 neocloud 合作伙伴做出类似的信用包装承诺，就像它之前对 Fluidstack 所做的那样，以及这种支持是否会降低融资成本。”

该报告还强化了对人工智能基础设施的投资将保持强劲的预期，特别是如果其他主要科技公司继续增加先进计算能力的资本支出。
